entity.name: Callx maintainers
entity.description: Independent maintainers of Callx, an open-source native calling library for Flutter and React Native.

projects.name: Callx
projects.description: Native incoming and outgoing calls for Flutter and React Native: one shared Swift and Kotlin core that owns CallKit, Android Core-Telecom, VoIP and FCM push handling, and crash recovery, so calls ring and stay correct even when the app is not running. Bring your own backend and media; no telemetry.

channels.description: Buy Me a Coffee, one-time support

plans.name: Maintenance and release verification
plans.description: Part-time maintenance: iOS and Android releases and betas, provider SDK upgrades, issues and security fixes, running the emulator matrix and acceptance checklist for every release, and reviewing device results from the community.

plans.name: Platform costs
plans.description: Apple Developer Program, which VoIP push and CallKit testing need, and macOS CI minutes.
